description: Builds stateful AI agents using LangGraph — the graph-based state machine framework for agents with complex conditional flows, retry loops, error recovery, and built-in HITL checkpoints. Covers when to choose LangGraph over LangChain or CrewAI, core concepts (StateGraph, TypedDict state, nodes, edges, conditional edges, reducers, checkpointers), and implementation patterns for production agent workflows. Activates when building agents with complex branching logic, designing agents that need to loop until a condition is met, implementing state machines for agent workflows, adding error recovery to agent loops, building agents that need to pause for human approval at specific graph nodes, or migrating from sequential LangChain agents to stateful LangGraph agents. Also triggers on: LangGraph, StateGraph, stateful agent, conditional agent, agent loop, graph-based agent, agent branching, LangGraph HITL, agent checkpointer.
